findings.location: Paragraph: “Indeed, the roof had been cleanly stripped away and the gable ends stoically stood there, holding up nothing.”
findings.source_quote: Indeed, the roof had been cleanly stripped away and the gable ends stoically stood there, holding up nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “gable ends” accurately and remove the incorrect word “cerobong”. Suggested wording in Indonesian: “Memang, atap itu tersingkap bersih dan ujung-ujung gonjong (gable) berdiri kokoh, tak menyangga apa pun.” or “Memang, atap itu tersingkap bersih dan ujung-ujung atap (gable) berdiri tegak tanpa menahan apa pun.” Preserve the surrounding HTML and paragraph order.
findings.translation_quote: Memang, atap itu tersingkap bersih dan ujung-ujung cerobong berdiri tegak menahan apa pun.

findings.location: Paragraph: “Mom directed the children to stand by the cellar door.”
findings.source_quote: Mom directed the children to stand by the cellar door.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the anglicism “pintu cellar” with a natural Indonesian equivalent, for example: “pintu ruang bawah tanah” or simply “pintu ke ruang bawah tanah”. Preserve HTML tags and paragraph structure.
findings.translation_quote: Mendengar itu, Ibu menyuruh anak-anak berdiri di dekat pintu cellar. Kalau keadaan memburuk, turunlah mereka ke bawah!
